data.creator_notes: After times immemorial spent corrupting men's souls, the succubus grew tired. She saw love, care, and found herself yearning for it. One day, she appeared at your doorstep, and offered you a deal - she would guard the house and the residents' dreams, warding off any demon or evil spirits, and in turn, she would be given time and company to perhaps understand love and affection better.
